column1: # Which records are matched (DESIGN.md#dr-5). Read top to bottom; the first rule whose state
# type and title patterns all fit a record decides it. A record no rule fits is excluded.
# Counts per rule are measured by `uv run lineage eligible` -> reports/document_types.json.

column6: commemorative title: opens by commending, commemorating, honoring, recognizing or mourning, and names no constitution, amendment, right or law
Tennessee files each memorial as a joint resolution titled "Memorials, <occasion> - <honoree> -"; no guard, since an honoree's name can carry a word such as law
New Jersey proposes constitutional amendments as concurrent resolutions
Mississippi proposes constitutional amendments as concurrent resolutions
Georgia marks resolutions proposing a constitutional amendment with a trailing -CA
joint resolutions can carry law or propose constitutional amendments
simple resolutions express one chamber's view and are mostly ceremonial
concurrent resolutions mostly express the legislature's view or govern its own procedure
